headline: Content Writer
summary: Content writer with a year at a digital agency writing blogs, product copy and newsletters for food, travel and real-estate brands. I edit my own and teammates' drafts against each client's style guide and rewrite older articles so they read fresh and rank again. I want to specialise in long-form brand content.
skills: Copywriting for product pages and ads

experience.title: Content Writer
bullets: Write about 12 articles and 40 product descriptions a month for six clients.
Drafted the style guide for a Bacolod bakery chain and now edit all its content against it.
Rewrote 30 old travel posts for a resort client; half returned to the first page of search results.
Send weekly progress notes to clients and handle their revision requests.

experience.title: Editorial Intern
bullets: Proofread feature stories and wrote short event listings for the online edition.

education.credential: Bachelor of Arts in English Language Studies
